snippet.title: Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection Console Announcement | Coming Soon
snippet.description:
Consoles have been missing Two Point Hospital DLC's for years. We've just found the cure.

The Full Health Collection is coming soon to Xbox X|S, PS5, and Nintendo Switch 2, injected with every piece of DLC.

Stay tuned for more info!
